heading: INT. ABANDONED DRIVE-IN PROJECTION BOOTH - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ABANDONED DRIVE-IN PROJECTION BOOTH - NIGHT
A cinderblock room, the size of a closet.
A dead projector the color of old teeth squats in the middle.
Spray-painted names cover the walls.
A battery lantern throws everything into hard shadow.
YUSUF HAMDAN (17, thin, nervous laugh, a cheap digital camera on a strap) sits on an overturned crate.
Beside him, LUCINDA "LUCKY" MORROW (17, bleached hair, scraped knees) plays with a lighter.
BARNABY QUILL (18, built like a linebacker, soft voice) blocks the doorway.
DAHLIA REYES (16, hoodie, headphones around her neck) holds a flask she shouldn't have.
MAGNUS WICK (17, varsity jacket, too clean) stands apart from them.
You said you'd be here at nine.
units.name: LUCKY

units.text: I was here at nine.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: You were not here at nine, I was here at nine, I sat alone for twenty minutes--
units.name: DAHLIA

units.text: It's not a big deal, we're all here now--
units.name: YUSUF

units.text: It is a big deal! We swore. After graduation, nobody leaves without--
units.name: LUCKY

units.text: Lucky.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: --without saying it to everyone, that's the rule!
units.name: LUCKY

units.text: There's no rule. You made it up.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: She did not make it up, we all signed the wall.
units.name: DAHLIA

units.text: Dahlia jabs a finger at the concrete.
Under a layer of paint, five signatures sit in a ragged circle.
Technically, I signed it in marker. Pretty permanent.
units.name: YUSUF

units.text: I'm going to Dartmouth. Fine? I got in. It's done. I didn't want to tell you like this.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: Silence.
Then everyone speaks at once.
Dartmouth?
units.name: LUCKY

units.text: You said Ohio State.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Why would you lie about that?
units.name: DAHLIA

units.text: Congratulations, I guess?
units.name: YUSUF

units.text: Because I knew you'd all look like this!
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: Barnaby steps in from the doorway.
Magnus doesn't back up.
Like what?
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Like I already left.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: Lucky snaps the lighter shut.
The lantern flickers.
Yusuf lifts the camera and, without asking, takes one picture of all of them.
The flash leaves white afterimages.
Nobody says anything.
